inlines.v: INOFFENS'IVE, adjective [in and offensive.] 1. Giving no offense or provocation; as an inoffensive man; an inoffensive answer. 2. Giving no uneasiness or disturbance; as an inoffensive appearance or sight. 3. Harmless; doing no injury or mischief. Thy inoffensive satires never bite. 4. Not obstructing; presenting no hinderance. --From hence a passage broad, Smooth, easy, inoffensive down to hell.
